segments.text: Right, let's review the Bureau & Co trade fair in Lyon. Our booth is eighteen square meters in hall 3, and the fair opens in five weeks. I'd like us to leave with a clear list of who does what.
On the sales side, I already have forty client meetings booked over the two days. We'll need three people on the booth at all times, otherwise we'll miss people.
For logistics, the carrier can deliver the six demonstration chairs the morning before. He needs the exact address of the delivery dock. I'll confirm it to him before November 6.
Perfect. Now the brochures: the old version still shows last year's prices. Bastien, could you rework the price grid before we send it back to print?
I'm not committing to that, I'm on the road until Thursday. We'll talk about it again. For the giveaways, any ideas?
I was going to suggest tote bags embroidered with our logo, like last year.
No, not tote bags. Everybody hands them out, and at four euros each for five hundred bags, that's two thousand euros. I'd rather offer a free fifteen-day trial of a chair.
A home trial is doable, but only around Lyon and Grenoble. Beyond that, transport costs too much.
Then we drop the tote bags and go with the free fifteen-day trial, limited to Lyon and Grenoble. Does everyone agree?
Agreed, that's settled for me.
Same for me.
There are still the exhibitor badges. The organizer gives us five, and the names have to be declared before registration closes, otherwise we pay the visitor rate to get in.
And the motorized chair demonstration on the booth, who's doing it?
I can already hear Bastien telling me: “the demo is mine, I know it by heart.” Except that with forty meetings, I don't see when he'd do it.
We'll see once his schedule is final. Next point, the hotel: who can book the rooms for the three nights?
Nobody? Fine, I'll take care of it myself. I'll book by Friday.
I'll send you the hall 3 floor plan tomorrow morning, I got it from the organizer last week.
Thanks, that plan will help. And I'm correcting what I said about the carrier: the organizer only assigns the docks on November 8, so I'll confirm the address to him on November 9 instead of the 6th.
Bastien, we need the booth staffing schedule. Can you prepare it, with your meeting slots?
Yes, that one I'll do. I'll send it to you on Monday.
Thanks. To recap: a free fifteen-day trial for Lyon and Grenoble, I book the hotel, Mehdi confirms the address to the carrier and Bastien sends the staffing schedule. We'll check in again in a week.
